## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any relevant checks not run.

For a UI change, include desktop and narrow-screen screenshots. For website preview changes, identify the fixture/site and browser interactions tested. For localization, check both English and French.

## Deployment notes

Describe migrations, configuration changes or compatibility limits when applicable. Remove this section for changes that need none.
